title: Luscious Dense Italian Sausage Pasta
description: A cultured and indulgent Venezuelan dish featuring Italian fennel sausages, this whole30-friendly pasta is cooked to an al-dente finish. The combination of sausage, vegetables, and herbs creates a rich and satisfying flavor profile.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until it is al-dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and cook the sliced sausages until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced zucchini, bell peppers, and chopped onions to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the sausage and vegetables.
Season the pasta with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
